title: MV Need Feedback For My Game Prototype

posts.author: Rexone
posts.body:
Hello, i need feedback for my game prototype which i make for my thesis to graduate . . . .  so please help me graduate :'D
Aside for thesis, i also need user feedback because i feel my game kinda bland and not unique, so i hope with your feedback it will spark my brain with a nice idea
, also there is a demo at the bottom of thread and i'm not native english speaker so sorry with my bad grammar.
​
The Reason Making This Prototype
For personal reason i just love Manna Khemia battle style, waiting a brand new remake or similar game adapting that style. Alas, 12 year waiting it never come (or just me that's unaware). That's why instead waiting again, i just do it myself. I also wanted the full game have feels of challenge like playing darkest dungeon (but not super very hard) and have good story building like Octopath Traveler.
​
Spoiler:
About Concept
Why naming it "Runagate" ?
Runagate is a synonym of "runaway" or alteration or latin of "regenade" word that's often used on medieval time. Other is define it's word as "a person who drift or wanders about". Inside the story all of playable character is a "runagate" which they fled from their own problem afraid and wander about it's problem. This is some example that i wanted to explain from "runagate" word on my game :
Our MC "Zeyn" are an ex-assasin labeled as traitor who run away from mission. Zeyn was an envious to someone good life, good family and freedom, worrying nothing and laughing everyday which lead his uncontrollable behavior despising other people good life but one day, Zeyn got mission to killing lot of innoncent people , he confused why he can't killing them ? why his heart is hesitated ? it's his dream to cut their happines . . . but again he can't, something inside his heart stopping him for doing that. Zeyn thinking again " it's what i want ? is this the dream that i wanted ? " he afraid facing it and runaway far from it's homeland trying to figure out at the beginning what is a he really wanted to achieve in life . . . .​
" Should i facing it ? should i run again ? Please someone . . . free me from this curse "
Gameplay and story concept
The concept for gameplay are majorly adventure, taking quest at guild, and uncover the truth of the world. Player will play as "Zeyn" and begin the journey on new continent (still no name). Player can choose wheter trying recruit another "runagate" with doing their "fated encounter" , leave them or ruining their life which will affecting the ending of game. When you leave them too long (game progress too far) their "fated encounter" become "Ended Encounter" either they dead or missing but, if you choosing to ruin their life, they will become either hostile to you or dead.
For battle gameplay i wanted combining stamina on turn based, it's just my experience when playing darkest dungeon there is "stress" meter. It feel immersive how intense or despair the battle was. I wanted my game can achieve intense battle like "the longer you battle the more risk you to dead". When player at low stamina let's say under 50%, they will got slight tired giving minor debuff (-5% stats?) , at under 30% it become tired debuff (-10% stats?) and under 15% become fatigued debuff (-15% stats). I also wanted when its reach 0 the player will fainted (not dead) and unable take action for 2 turn and when wake up it will give 20 Stamina Point (SP). But how to balance it ? for now i just thinking about giving camping system where player can take a rest on specific area on map also giving ability to make or take breakfast/lunch/dinner to restore the stamina and gain various buff (Once per day). I also giving passive regen which already inside the demo but will nerf the regen time after i release the camping and taking breakfast/lunch/dinner.​
For now it's the concept for the game, it's still very rought and unpolish so please share your opinion about it
.
Game Prototype Mechanic
It's a turn-based RPG with Health Point (HP), Mana Point (MP) and Stamina Point (SP).
The character max stamina capacity at 100.
Added [Rest] action use for skip the turn to recover 15 Stamina Point (SP).
Have regen which slowly heal character HP,MP and SP outside of battle.
There is no [Attack] and [Skill] instead it become [Action] which consisting skill of character with variety of cost from HP,MP,SP and item.
There is no currency drop from monster, instead some of it's material are guaranteed to drop so player can sell it for money.
Player can allocate point for boost character stats.
What's Inside Prototype Demo ?

Unique NPC for story

Adding mini map
Adding variety of new enemies and it's animation
Adding behavior of enemies that chasing player on specific range of sight.
Adding kind of monsterpedia on esc menu
Adding variety of skill for character and enemies
Adding crafting and blacksmith NPC
Adding attack action animation to initiate the battle

Feedback
My big question would be - what is the point of your thesis supposed to be? And how long did you spend on it?
There's not much content here - I think I finished it in about ten minutes. So if you've had all semester (6 months) or longer, and I was your professor, I'd be asking what you did with all that time
The best part of the demo is definitely the custom art, but unless your focus is on video game art, I'm not sure that's a great excuse for taking up your time.
Rexone said:
The sprite movement only facing right and left
Click to expand...
I didn't like that. I think it looks weird for the character to be standing in place, doing a sort of moonwalk, and sliding up or down on the screen. It comes across more like an excuse to not draw the front and back of the character than something you chose to do.
My biggest problem was the English. I know you said it in your first post, so I pushed through, but it's pretty painfully bad. I have to think if you had bothered to use Google translate or anything else, it would at least have fixed some of the really big mistakes (like "I" is capitalized, and "iam" which you have a ton of times, is not a word, and you don't put a space before exclamation marks...).
Your game doesn't tell the player how to play. You can use arrow keys or click the ground with the mouse, but you never say that. Also, many gamers may try WASD before arrow keys, and that doesn't work here.
Why is there a HUD showing HP/MP/SP on the map while you're walking around? You usually see that information where it matters. If you're not fighting enemies on the map, like an ABS, then I don't want to see that floating there. There's also a glitch where it shows for a few frames at the beginning of the game before the black screen.
Shralj's first message - "Oh hello there" - vanishes too fast to actually read.
The way you make the battle camera zoom in every time an action starts cuts off battlers. Like, I'll select an action and it zooms in and I see half a bat sticking out of the side. (I also feel, for my tastes, that there's too much zooming back and forth. It's more distracting than it is cinematic)
Shralj talks about being eager for you to buy stuff then disappears without actually letting you do so.
Potions confusingly say both +20 HP and +10% HP. It makes more sense if you see the item description, but that's way up at the top corner of the screen, which is far away from the information chart right in the center. For such small values of HP, it doesn't seem like the 10% serves a purpose. 10% is either 4 or 5 for the entire demo - it doesn't really make a difference. Just heal for 25 HP.
Even ignoring the difficult English, the logic of convincing the slime by sparring with them doesn't make sense to me.
The aftermath level up screen is too narrow, some of the parameters are cut off on the right.
Because all of the enemies are Action Button trigger, the player can just walk around all of them unless they choose to attack and do more battles (which aren't really interesting).
The skills are made to do different things, but they don't really provoke interesting choices. It's a matter of "use the one that's obviously better until you run out of MP." Even when you get your third skill, 2 attacks at 50% aren't as good as 3 attacks at 40%.
And why are all of the skills at low percentages of your attack? If there isn't anything that does 100%, it seems like the number is pointless - just make his ATK be 6 instead of 12 to begin with.
It doesn't make sense that Cross Slash does "3 hits" which are one motion and pop up simultaneously, but Puncture Slash does 2 hits and each has its own motion and action effect.
End screen says there's a readme in the Google Drive folder, but there isn't.
Really important
: I don't see any form of credits in this project. You're using plugins written by other people, which require credit in their terms of use; I don't know if you drew all of the art on your own, but RPG Maker MV itself requires you to display certain credits in its EULA. I didn't see a credits scroll at the end, nothing on the title screen, not even a text document in the game folder.
Edit: Also, what is this supposed to achieve?
Game_Interpreter.wait() doesn't return a value, so that's not going to do anything.
Edit 2: I also think your Google Sheet survey could have more reasonable categories. For example, there's a big area between "I love it a lot" and "rarely".
